summary: Computer vision engineer who ships real-time perception systems for constrained hardware. Experienced in taking models from training notebooks to reliable edge deployment.

bullets: Built a real-time detector reaching 25 FPS on edge hardware.
Improved recall by 12% on an internal benchmark.
Developed vision-based targeting and precision landing software.
Integrated sensor fusion into the flight-control stack.

projects.problem: Drones lose navigation when GPS is unavailable.
projects.solution: Matched aerial imagery against georeferenced tiles with learned features.
projects.outcome: Estimated position within 8 metres during live flight tests.
